init_multigrid_schedule: initialize a MultigridSchedule object and call init_multigrid to update training config with multigrid hyperparameters
update_long_cycle_shape: call update_long_cycle on a MultigridSchedule instance to adjust batch size and crop size for the current epoch
get_long_cycle_schedule: call get_long_cycle_schedule on a MultigridSchedule instance to compute the long cycle training schedule from config
print_multigrid_schedule: call print_schedule with a schedule list to log long cycle index, base shape, and epochs to the logger
get_current_long_cycle_shape: call get_current_long_cycle_shape with a schedule and epoch index to retrieve the current base shape tuple
